_comment: PC-8801 (RA console 47 / LaunchBox platform 'NEC PC-8801') per-game N88-BASIC MACHINE-MODE map for the RAQUASI88 standalone emulator. The PC-8801mkII SR (early 1985) introduced the V1S/V1H/V2 modes; pre-SR (<=1984) software is V1, 1985+ SR-era software is V2. A V1 game run in V2 silently mis-renders (wrong colours / speed) with no error, whereas a V2 game run in V1 shows a visible 'V2 mode required' message -- so overriding OLD titles to V1H is the low-risk direction. Community guidance (libretro QUASI88 docs) recommends V1H as the general V1 mode; V1S is only for the rare title that runs too fast in V1H (none identified in this set).
_usage: render_launchbox emits each <Game>'s <CommandLine>. A per-game <CommandLine> in Data\Platforms\'NEC PC-8801.xml' OVERRIDES (replaces, does NOT append to) the EmulatorPlatform default CommandLine in Data\Emulators.xml -- so the fullscreen flags must be repeated in every override. For a game whose ra_game_id is in 'overrides', set <CommandLine> = overrides[id].args. For every other PC-8801 game leave <CommandLine> EMPTY so it inherits the platform default ('default_args'). Match preferably by games.ra_game_id (render has this from the DB); the 'rom' field (zip basename, no extension) is provided as a fallback match key for tooling that works off the deployed LaunchBox XML, where <RetroAchievementsId> is often absent.
note_sound_board: Sound Board II (OPNA/YM2608) is enabled GLOBALLY via '-sd2' in the emulator's QUASI88.ini (Emulators\RAQUASI88\QUASI88.ini), NOT per-game and NOT in the command line -- it applies to every launch regardless of the per-game CommandLine. Do not add -sd2 to args here.
